nodes.klein: to divide, separate. v. he divided, separated (in the Bible occurring only Ezek. 1:11 in the pass. part. פָּרוּד). was divided, was separated. he went apart (in the Bible occurring only Hos. 4:14 in the form יֽפָרֵדוּ); he separated; he decomposed, resolved into constituent parts (chemistry). was divided, was separated (in the Bible occurring only in the part. מְפֹרָד). was divided, was separated; was scattered, was dispersed. he made a division, separated; he decomposed, resolved into its constituent parts. was separated; was decomposed, was resolved into its constituents.

nodes.g: to divide, share, plunder, allot, apportion, assign to be smooth, slippery, deceitful
to be distinct, marked out, be separated, be distinguished
to be divided into, divide, branch off
